name: Tinkercad
title: tinkercad.com
payoff: Free 3D design and coding web app
shortDescription: Tinkercad is a free, user-friendly web application for 3D design, electronics, and coding, serving over 75 million users globally. It's designed for educators and students, enhancing STEM education through project-based learning. Users can start creating instantly without any downloads, making it ideal for classroom integration. Example use cases include designing 3D models, electronic circuits, and coding projects to bring designs to life.
